programs.description: An anthology of three stories. The first story involves a murder investigation, the second story is about a group of goons following a girl, the third involves five friends delivering a package.
Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.
Viswanathan, a loyal home minister, sincerely works for the welfare of the people. However, he faces many challenges when he encounters an evil politician, Natarajan.
Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
A car that Mahadevan wins in a contest brings him bad luck, and he soon gets involved in a murder. As he tries to find a car with the same license number as his, he unravels a shocking truth.
Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.
In the 1960s, when interreligious marriages were still taboo, Moideen and Kanchanamala fell in love. Even after being forced to part ways, the two lovers fight for their undying love.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Etho Janma Kalpanayil
Chandrikayilaliyunna Chandrakantham
While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
Ayyappan, a tabla player in a drama troupe, mysteriously disappears, leading CI Jacob Eeraly to uncover hidden secrets as he investigates the lives of those around him.
